levels.name: Vigilant Sentinel
levels.description: After Illuga triggers a Geo-related Reaction on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.

levels.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
levels.description: When Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection's Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of Nightingale's Song consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of Geo DMG to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

levels.name: Earthshaking Maw
levels.description: Increases the Level of Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Solarhunting Wolf
levels.description: When Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection's Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, nearby active party members will have their DEF increased by 200.

levels.name: Hurricane Steed
levels.description: Increases the Level of Elemental Skill Dawnbearing Songbird by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Nightmare Orioles
levels.description: Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent Torchforger's Covenant: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Torchforger's Covenant."
